source.summary: GitHub Actions ‘Embedder footprint’ runs for PR #349 (branch fix/335-handle-validation at head 695d95648431e72da3349a072e7684d7e4651aef — the #335 change (canonical handle operations validate handle indices against the instance table) with the Codex-review follow-up (host-provided handles pass through on a local-index collision, and two synthetic import-path identities of one provider resource are not distinguished at the boundary), merged with current main b20ed79513bbb12f6e4447158fd4028808ac129b (PRs #350 and #353); ubuntu-24.04, Rust 1.96.0): workflow_dispatch runs 45596285864 and 45596292563 against the branch and pull-request run 45596294067, which built the same tree, produced byte-identical sizes for every gated series
source.derivation: Re-baseline for PR #349 (#335, canonical handle operations validate handle indices against the instance table; third re-baseline for this PR, after the Codex-review follow-up commit and the merges of PR #350 (#330, merge commit d8e85b9) and PR #353 (#318, merge commit 695d956) into the branch — main at b20ed79513bbb12f6e4447158fd4028808ac129b; the #353 merge conflicted in the vendored exclusion table, resolved as the union of both removals (the handle-table.wast entry and the three extern-name entries all stay removed), and in the baseline files, resolved by taking main's baseline as the base for this campaign). Attribution was isolated by measuring current main alone three times (workflow_dispatch runs 45596237962, 45596246881 and 45596255577 on main at b20ed79513bbb12f6e4447158fd4028808ac129b; all three runs pass the gate against main's checked-in baseline, and the main control is byte-identical to that baseline on all 32 gated series). This PR's own delta against the main control is confined to the series of the three configurations that link telomere-component: in release, stripped file +4,528 B and stripped .text +3,456 B in each of component, wasi and wasi-threads; in release-size, stripped file +3,368 B and stripped .text +2,272 B in each. Every other configuration is byte-identical to main in both profiles. All twelve series exceed the checked-in baseline and are re-baselined to the branch measurements; every other baseline is unchanged. Run-to-run spread was 0 B for every gated series across the three branch samples and across the three main samples. Against the original #164 baseline, the largest cumulative growth is the release component stripped file series at +11.21% (2,433,656 B to 2,706,384 B); the step from the previous +10.47% is PR #353's own growth, already absorbed into main's baseline. The core-aot configuration, added by PR #267 after the #164 baseline, is not part of the cumulative comparison.
